command: set -u; P=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts; echo FINAL_TREE=$P; for f in voice_final_runtime.py voice_full_runtime.py voice_host_live_client.py frank_terminal.py; do if [ -f "$P/$f" ]; then echo PRESENT:$f; sha256sum "$P/$f"; else echo MISSING:$f; fi; done; echo EFFECTIVE=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null); echo PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null); echo ENTER=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value 2>/dev/null)
